uni-course-scheduler 2.6.0

- Added feature flag system to control experimental user categories (graduate, exchange, double-degree, etc.); only the undergraduate core workflow is always ON and production-critical.
- Clarified and formalized strict routing rules for execution modes (cloud vs local), including mandatory catalog collection and pre-flight checklist for cloud runs.
- Enhanced documentation: expanded on each workflow step with precise enum mapping and guidance for user input, credit systems, execution options, payment method routing, and quality gates.
- Updated and clarified cloud platform routing: now explicitly selects payment route (China vs international) by user payment method, not by IP or geography.
- Strengthened distinction between production/batch use (cloud only) and personal/single-school use (local only), with watermarked output for personal local runs.
